profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to launching a Live Course Platform for LSAT
- Worked with AWS Lambda microservices in Golang and Python backed by DynamoDB, Redis, and Elasticsearch
- Extended Terraform and Gitlab Continuous Integration Pipelines
- Experienced a remote agile environment. Lots of agency

positions.title: Head Volleyball Coach
positions.description: Led a 16s National Team through a great season!

positions.title: Technology Innovation Intern
positions.description:
Built a Conversational AI Interface for text and voice queries that made it easy for Chick-fil-A people to access existing financial, training, and sales data.

Learned several core skills in AWS, more about Twilio, and experimented with open source and commercial NLP toolkits. Also learned I'll never tire of Waffle Fries
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Computing · AWS Lambda · Data Science · Machine Learning

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Built a visualization and planning tool for Intra-Logistics Warehouse Management in a collaboration between Georgia Tech's Supply Chain and Logistics Institute, the Physical Internet Center, and Daimler AG.

Our team's work secured a 6-figure investment expanding the project.

projects.title: Sensory Addition for Language
projects.description: Built upon haptic communication research to create a wearable that translates speech into tactile sensations, creating a haptic language. We ran a pilot study to determine if people could learn to recognize haptic "syllables" using a wearable device.
